notes: Strip f, x 8030-10750 plus ~300 px overlap. Montgomery Road's east side is the plate edge along the whole strip, so its centre was estimated midway between the west block face and the plate edge (checked against the street-railway tracks). Woodburn jogs twice: ~195 px at Brewster (two T picks) and ~75 px at Blair (one cross pick at the centre). Brewster and Jonathan block faces have house numbers printed inside the street; centres taken between block faces. Harlem Place slants (x~7945 at Jonathan, x~8000 at Blair). Unnamed streets: 50 ft street between Brewster and Herbert at x~9170 (probably part of Herbert), two street mouths north of Brewster, stub east of Woodburn at y~455, 'HO...' street east of Montgomery at y~3710, stub east of the Gilbert/Montgomery/Woodburn junction, and two stubs south of Gilbert ('...LL AVE' at x~7716 and an illegible one at x~8240).
